automationNotes: Steps mirror the document exactly in order: Install section → Full Page section → Entry Sidebar section. Install steps are click-only (no verify) as the user instructed. The install authorization page (not a modal — full page) uses a cs-select dropdown (input[aria-label='cs-select-aria']) for stack selection. The ToS checkbox step uses warnOnly=true with :not(:checked) selector — skips gracefully when already pre-checked (avoids unchecking it). Post-install navigation fails in the QA env because Audience Insights requires Lytics configuration to appear in the stack navigation.
